title: Update on the Leverage for Selected Assets Under Binance Portfolio Margin (2026-08-21)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  Portfolio Margin leverage  for the following assets from  2026-08-21 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes . Assets  Leverage (Before) Leverage (After) ADA, BFUSD, BNB, BNSOL, DOGE, RLUSD, SOL, U, USD1, USDE, USDP, USDS, WBETH, XRP 5 10 1INCH, AAVE, ALGO, APE, API3, ASTR, AUCTION, BICO, C98, CELO, CHR, CKB, CYBER, DASH, EGLD, ENJ, FET, FLOKI, FLUX, GMT, GRT, ID, IMX, KSM, LUNA, MAGIC, MINA, NEAR, NMR, PENDLE, PEOPLE, RAY, RLC, ROSE, RUNE, SFP, SKL, SLP, SSV, STG, SUSHI, THETA, UMA, ZEC, ZEN, ZIL 3 5 BANANAS31, KMNO, MUBARAK, NXPC, PROM, SYRUP, TUT, ZRO 10 5 Please Note:  Leverage  will affect  the Unified Maintenance Margin Ratio (uniMMR) under Portfolio Margin. Users should monitor uniMMR closely to avoid any potential liquidation or losses that may result from the change of collateral ratio and leverage.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
